source: 更新下载身份不完整，请重新检查官方发布。
en: The update download identity is incomplete. Check the official release again.

source: 更新下载身份与固定官方发布不一致，已拒绝安装。
en: The update download identity does not match the fixed official release. Installation was refused.

source: 请从原始单文件 EXE 启动 Process Keeper 后使用此功能。
en: Start Process Keeper from its original single EXE to use this feature.

source: 可信启动信息不属于当前运行的应用。
en: The trusted launcher context does not belong to this running app.

source: 此功能需要已验证的管理员启动器。
en: This feature requires the verified administrator launcher.

source: 更新文件未通过 SHA-256 校验。
en: The update file failed SHA-256 verification.

source: 更新版本必须高于当前原始 EXE 的版本。
en: The update version must be newer than this original EXE.

source: 更新助手在就绪前退出，原始 EXE 未被替换。
en: The update helper stopped before it was ready. The original EXE was not replaced.

source: 已验证的更新助手已就绪，退出应用后完成更新。
en: The verified update helper is ready. Exit this app to finish updating.

source: 更新助手未能就绪，原始 EXE 未被替换。
en: The update helper did not become ready. The original EXE was not replaced.

source: 更新助手未确认接管，应用将保持运行，原始 EXE 不会被替换。
en: The update helper did not acknowledge the handoff. The app will stay open and the original EXE will not be replaced.

source: 无法启动已验证的快捷方式助手。
en: The verified shortcut helper could not start.

source: 快捷方式操作尚未完成，请稍后重试。
en: The shortcut operation has not finished. Try again later.

source: 已创建指向原始 EXE 的桌面快捷方式。
en: A desktop shortcut to the original EXE was created.

source: 桌面快捷方式已存在并指向原始 EXE。
en: The desktop shortcut already points to the original EXE.

source: 桌面已有无关的同名快捷方式，未覆盖。
en: An unrelated shortcut with the same name already exists and was left unchanged.

source: 无法创建桌面快捷方式，原有文件未被覆盖。
en: The desktop shortcut could not be created. Existing files were left unchanged.
